_about: Hand-checked answers the directory matcher uses before its own rules (specs/campus-directories.md#review). Key: the campus exactly as a list prints it, a bar, and the two-letter state the list gives (empty when it gives none). Value: the IPEDS unit ids it means ([] = checked, not a college on the site). Add one only after checking the college; say why in _why.
